skill.name: lark-calendar
skill.description: Lark Calendar automation for schedules, meetings, attendees, free-busy checks, time recommendations, RSVP, and meeting-room booking.
skill.summary: Manage Lark Calendar events, meeting rooms, availability, RSVP, and meeting details.
skill.author: larksuite

security_audit.summary: The static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code spans, documentation links, identifier examples, and Chinese documentation entropy. No prompt injection, encoded payload, or executable code was found in the reviewed skill files. Two semantic concerns remain: broad external date-tool instructions and long-term preference retention without explicit consent.

remediation.issue: External date conversion guidance is too broad.
remediation.suggestion: Replace the instruction with an allowlisted date helper or exact safe commands, and forbid shell interpolation of user-provided text.

remediation.issue: Long-term preference retention lacks consent controls.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user consent before saving personal time preferences, and document where the preference is stored and how to remove it.

remediation.issue: Markdown links and command examples create noisy static findings.
remediation.suggestion: Keep examples, but add author notes that links are documentation-only and command snippets require normal user authorization.

content.value_statement: Coordinating Lark Calendar meetings and rooms requires several commands. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through search, availability checks, updates, RSVP, and room booking.
actual_capabilities: Search and review Lark calendar events by date, keyword, attendee, or event ID.
Create events with ISO 8601 times, attendees, rooms, reminders, and recurrence rules.
Update event titles, descriptions, times, recurrence rules, attendees, and rooms.
Query free-busy status and suggest available time slots for participants.
Find available meeting rooms for confirmed time blocks and guide room selection.
Retrieve meeting IDs and linked meeting notes for calendar events.
limitations: Requires lark-cli authentication and required Lark permissions.
Does not manage tasks, instant messages, contacts, or physical room facilities.
Past video meeting history should use the Lark VC skill.
Write operations still require clear user intent and confirmation for choices.

use_cases.title: Plan an executive meeting
use_cases.description: Find attendee availability, suggest time options, and create the confirmed Lark Calendar event.

use_cases.title: Update a recurring team event
use_cases.description: Locate the correct instance, confirm the edit scope, and apply safe recurrence changes.

use_cases.title: Book a suitable meeting room
use_cases.description: Search available rooms for selected time blocks and present clear options for confirmation.

prompt_templates.title: Review my agenda
prompt_templates.prompt: Use lark-calendar to show my agenda for tomorrow. Group the results by date and sort them by start time.

prompt_templates.title: Create a meeting
prompt_templates.prompt: Schedule a 30-minute product review with Li Wei and the design group next Tuesday afternoon. Suggest available times first.

prompt_templates.title: Find a room
prompt_templates.prompt: Find an available room for a 45-minute meeting tomorrow afternoon with the project leads. Show time and room options before booking.

prompt_templates.title: Reschedule a recurring event
prompt_templates.prompt: Move the weekly planning meeting from next week onward to Friday afternoon. Preserve the original duration and ask before applying changes.

output_examples.input: What is on my calendar tomorrow?
output: Tomorrow has three events, listed in start-time order.
The assistant groups events by date and notes cancelled events are excluded.
If there are no events, it says the calendar is clear.

output_examples.input: Find a room for a one-hour meeting tomorrow afternoon.
output: The assistant suggests candidate time blocks first.
For each confirmed block, it lists available rooms on separate lines.
It asks the user to choose a time and room before booking.

output_examples.input: Add Chen to the product review meeting.
output: The assistant locates the existing event before editing.
It treats attendee changes as an update, not a new event.
It confirms the target event when multiple matches exist.

best_practices: Confirm user intent before creating, updating, deleting, or replying to events.
Use explicit dates, times, and time zones when the user provides them.
Use time suggestions before room search when the requested time is vague.
anti_patterns: Do not guess a meeting room when no time block is known.
Do not use bot identity to query a user calendar.
Do not edit recurring events without confirming the intended scope.

faq.question: What does this skill need to run?
faq.answer: It needs lark-cli configured with valid Lark authentication and calendar permissions.

faq.question: Can it book meeting rooms?
faq.answer: Yes. It searches available rooms for known time blocks and asks the user to choose before booking.

faq.question: Can it handle vague times?
faq.answer: Yes. It can request suggested time blocks for vague ranges like tomorrow afternoon or this week.

faq.question: Does it manage recurring events?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes rules for editing one instance, all instances, or future instances.

faq.question: Can it fetch past video meeting records?
faq.answer: No. Past video meeting history belongs to the Lark VC workflow, not this calendar skill.

faq.question: Will it make changes without confirmation?
faq.answer: It should confirm user intent and choices before write operations or schedule changes.
